name: Vung Tau food guide
summary: Eat bánh khọt on Nguyễn Trường Tộ, one small cake at a time with herbs and fish sauce. After the swim, choose the fish at the Back Beach night market. The stingray pot is the sit-down meal. A stall price is check on arrival, and bánh khọt is not a folded bánh xèo.
body: Vietnam Tourism calls bánh khọt the snack a Vung Tau trip is incomplete without. Two pages describe the batter differently, and both are kept: rice flour fried in small molds, or flour and curry powder. The gesture is the same. Herbs around the cake, sauce on the side. It is not a folded bánh xèo.

The night seafood market is on Back Beach. You choose the fish, crab, or shellfish and the cooking. Nguyễn Trường Tộ and Hoàng Hoa Thám are the streets named for bánh khọt. Shop names stay off this page. Other bowls on the tourism list have no photograph of that bowl, so they are not cards.
specialtiesLead: The cakes and the fried dough are the plates with photographs. Other bowls stay in the notes until a picture of that bowl exists.
seoTitle: Vung Tau food guide — bánh khọt and the night catch
seoDescription: Vung Tau bánh khọt, one cake at a time on Nguyễn Trường Tộ, and seafood you choose on Back Beach after dark. A stall price is check on arrival.
